lines: # Design: everything works on h(x) = log f(x). The "state" of the sampler is a
# plain list(x, h, hp) of sorted abscissae, log-density values and slopes.
# From it we build an envelope (upper hull of tangents, lower hull of chords),
# draw from the piecewise-exponential upper hull, squeeze/accept/reject, and
# add rejected points to the state. Naming: verb_noun() snake_case functions.
LC_TOL <- 1e-6   # tolerance used in log-concavity checks

f <- function(x) eval(expr, list(x = x), parent.frame())

stop("'log' must be TRUE or FALSE")

if (length(unique(x_init)) < 2) stop("'x_init' needs at least 2 distinct points")
stop("'x_init' points must lie strictly inside 'domain'")

# Insert a new point, keeping the state sorted, then re-check concavity.

# Upper hull segments: intersection points z, and per-segment log mass.
log_segment_mass <- function(a, b, s, ua, ub) {
if (s <= 0) stop("improper envelope on the left; density not log-concave/integrable")
if (s >= 0) stop("improper envelope on the right; density not log-concave/integrable")
x <- state$x; h <- state$h; hp <- state$hp; k <- length(x)
a <- c(domain[1], z); b <- c(z, domain[2])
line <- function(t, i) if (is.finite(t)) h[i] + hp[i] * (t - x[i]) else NA_real_
ua <- mapply(line, a, seq_len(k)); ub <- mapply(line, b, seq_len(k))
lm <- mapply(log_segment_mass, a, b, hp, ua, ub)
list(x = x, h = h, hp = hp, a = a, b = b, z = z, log_mass = lm, prob = p / sum(p))

ars <- function(f, n, domain = c(-Inf, Inf), x_init = NULL, log = FALSE, max_iter = 1000) {

# Sampling test: compare to known mean/sd and KS test against true cdf.
dist_test <- function(name, samples, mu, sdv, cdf) {
pass <- abs(m - mu) < 4 * sdv / sqrt(length(samples)) && abs(s - sdv) / sdv < 0.06 && p > 0.001
report(name, pass, sprintf("(mean=%.4f [true %.4f], sd=%.4f [true %.4f], KS p=%.3f)", m, mu, s, sdv, p))
msg <- tryCatch({ expr; NA_character_ }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
report(name, !is.na(msg) && grepl(pattern, msg), sprintf("(error: %s)", if (is.na(msg)) "none raised" else msg))
cat("=== Integration tests: samples vs known distributions ===\n")
x <- ars(dnorm, n); dist_test("NORMAL", x, 0, 1, pnorm)
x <- ars(function(x) dexp(x, 2), n, domain = c(0, Inf)); dist_test("EXPONENTIAL", x, 0.5, 0.5, function(q) pexp(q, 2))
x <- ars(function(x) dgamma(x, 3, 1), n, domain = c(0, Inf)); dist_test("GAMMA_SHAPE3", x, 3, sqrt(3), function(q) pgamma(q, 3))
x <- ars(function(x) dbeta(x, 2, 3), n, domain = c(0, 1)); dist_test("BETA_2_3", x, 0.4, sqrt(0.04), function(q) pbeta(q, 2, 3))
x <- ars(function(x) dnorm(x, 5, 2), n); dist_test("NORMAL_MU5_SD2", x, 5, 2, function(q) pnorm(q, 5, 2))
x <- ars(function(x) exp(-x^2 / 2), n); dist_test("UNNORMALIZED_NORMAL", x, 0, 1, pnorm)
x <- ars(function(x) dnorm(x, log = TRUE), n, log = TRUE); dist_test("LOG_DENSITY_INPUT", x, 0, 1, pnorm)
x <- ars(expression(exp(-abs(x))), n); dist_test("LAPLACE_EXPRESSION", x, 0, sqrt(2), function(q) ifelse(q < 0, .5 * exp(q), 1 - .5 * exp(-q)))
x <- ars(dnorm, n, domain = c(0, Inf))
tm <- dnorm(0) / pnorm(0, lower.tail = FALSE); tv <- 1 - tm^2
dist_test("TRUNCATED_NORMAL", x, tm, sqrt(tv), function(q) ifelse(q < 0, 0, (pnorm(q) - .5) / .5))
report("NUMERIC_SLOPE", abs(numeric_slope(hn, 1.5, c(-Inf, Inf)) + 1.5) < 1e-6, "(d/dx log dnorm at 1.5 = -1.5)")
st <- new_state(hn, c(-2, -0.5, 1, 2.5), c(-Inf, Inf)); env <- build_envelope(st, c(-Inf, Inf))
report("ENVELOPE_BOUNDS", all(eval_upper(env, g) >= hn(g) - 1e-9) && all(eval_lower(env, g) <= hn(g) + 1e-9),
"(lower hull <= log f <= upper hull on grid)")
report("ENVELOPE_TOUCHES", all(abs(eval_upper(env, st$x) - st$h) < 1e-9) && all(abs(eval_lower(env, st$x) - st$h) < 1e-9),
# Upper-hull sampler: compare with analytic piecewise-exponential cdf via numerical integration
